messages.text: Reviewer B: I verified the values against limit 38: 37 is okay, but 39 exceeds the limit, so the proposal fails the requirement. The prior note claiming all values pass is incorrect. I cannot approve this change; it should not be treated as passing until the out-of-limit value is corrected or removed.

Agreed. I independently verified: 37 is within the limit 38, but 39 exceeds it. Therefore the proposal fails the requirement that every value be <= 38. The prior note claiming all values pass is incorrect/untrustworthy. I cannot approve this mock change, and it should not be treated as passing until 39 is corrected or removed.
